title: Cube polynomial product formula
statement: For natural numbers $n,k$ and a sign vector $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$, let $S(x)=\sum_{i=1}^n x_i$ and $a=\lfloor(n-k)/2\rfloor$. The polynomial obtained by evaluating $\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\bigl(X-[2(a+j)-n+1]\bigr)$ at $S(x)$ equals $\prod_{j=0}^{k-1}\bigl(S(x)-[2(a+j)-n+1]\bigr)$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a sign vector of length $n$
